mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM kit_knowledge_page p INNER JOIN kit_knowledge_page_block b ON b.page_version_id = p.current_version_id AND b.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN kit_knowledge_page_source_ref r ON r.page_block_id = b.id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND r.source_document_id = #{sourceDocumentId}
